The Code Underground

Coal mining law for the DGMS First Class Manager’s exam, in plain English: the OSH Code, 2020, the Coal Mines Regulations, 2017 and the mines parts of the OSH (Central) Rules, 2026, plus a fourth book of notes on Mine Management and General Safety. Pick a book, drag the timeline across the world, tap any dotted term for its meaning, and solve each stop’s situation from the seat you’re given.
